reading.body:
This record refers to 50 acres of land in Mesa, Arizona that EdgeConneX holds for build-to-suit development, not yet a completed facility. No power capacity, building footprint, or infrastructure specifications are published. The site is listed as available for future development on EdgeConneX's Phoenix area page, with no timeline announced for construction or operation.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities, of which only 4 publish power capacity figures totaling 512 MW. This Mesa site ranks fifth among published capacities in the state, but that ranking reflects an absence of data rather than confirmed capability. Until construction begins and specifications are released, no meaningful assessment of this campus's role in AI scaling can be made.

The campus matters to AI infrastructure planning only as a future option, not as current capacity. EdgeConneX operates over 90 facilities globally with ranges from 40 kW to 500 MW per site, but has not disclosed what scale or timeline it intends for the Mesa land. Investors and grid planners should treat this as contingent capacity with unknown specifications and no confirmed delivery date.
